validity.researcher_notes: The line is real. English Wikipedia lists it as a gas import pipeline entering Ukraine at Valuyki, and 2026 Kyiv Independent reporting names it as an abandoned pipe near Kupiansk. It is classed correctly as a transmission trunk. It matches no other row on the roster. The Shebelinka-Belgorod-Kursk-Bryansk line (P2387) runs a different way. The recorded length, diameter, capacity and start year have no independent source. Capacity of 22.5 is close to the 23 bcm/y seen on the wiki copies. The Ukrainian owner is unconfirmed.

fills.researcher_notes: No independent source found that names the owners of this line. The recorded pair is Gazprom for the Russian side and the Ukrainian gas transmission operator for the Ukrainian side. It is plausible for a line that crosses the border, but no document states it. The Ukrainian entity may instead be the state pipeline company that holds the assets since 2020.

fills.researcher_notes: English Wikipedia says the line enters Ukraine at the Valuyki gas metering station in Russia. The Kyiv Independent places the Ukrainian end in Kharkiv Oblast near Kupiansk. Neither names the town of Ostrogozhsk in Voronezh Oblast, so the Russian start town is not confirmed by these pages.

verifications.note: four abandoned gas pipelines ... The Shebelinka-Ostrogozhsk gas pipeline

fills.researcher_notes: The Kyiv Independent, reporting in 2026 on the battle for Kupiansk, calls the line one of four abandoned gas pipelines used by soldiers. It carries no gas. That supports a non-operating status. The source says abandoned, not mothballed. Two other outlets (United24 Media and Meduza) describe the same pipes but do not name this line, so they are not cited.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The Kyiv Independent reported in 2026 that this line is abandoned and carries no gas. Nothing newer shows gas flow. Mothballed stays the closest status. The report covers the Ukrainian section near Kupiansk, which is in a war zone. The source word is abandoned, so a person may want to decide between mothballed and retired.

summary: real abandoned import trunk; status confirm; specs and owners unresolved
